### Day 240: Acts 11:19–26
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-240-acts-11-1926.html
Passage: Acts 11:19-26
Points:
- God often works through bold believers willing to cross traditional boundaries to share the gospel with outsiders.
- Followers of Christ should resolve in advance to stay faithful rather than waiting until trials or temptations strike.
- Barnabas recognized the need for partnership and sought out Saul so they could teach and disciple the growing congregation together.
- Although the name "Christian" originated as an outsider's insult, it became the highest honor for believers.
